text:
ella: quick poll: do we name our dev models after pets or food? im team 'bagel' honestly :bagel:
kevin: pets. naming mine 'sasha' made debugging feel like therapy.
priya: i alternate. weekend models = pets, weekday models = snacks. unusual but works.
ella: i asked bagel-0.3 for career advice and it recommended 'batch responsibly' and a 2-week sabbatical. accurate. :joy:
mich: lol share the convo?
ella: ```
User: Bagel-0.3, how do I ask for a raise?
Bagel-0.3: Start by listing measurable wins, then ask for a time to talk. Also bring pastries.
```
kevin: pastries = true. also can we get a sticker that says "I ship, therefore I snack" ?
ops-bot: poll created: "Sticker slogan ideas" Options: ["I ship, therefore I snack","Batch responsibly","I cache, therefore I am"]
priya: voted "Batch responsibly" (also leak-free mugs pls)
mich: voted "I cache, therefore I am" for the meme potential.
ella: i'm designing tiny business cards for bagel-0.3 that say "Available for microconsults". low-key want them at onboarding.
kevin: can we stop naming models after my ex's dog though. traumatic. :sweat_smile:
priya: fair. new rule: no human exes or last names. food, fictional characters, or puns only.
ella: agreed. also who wants to make a LinkedIn for bagel-0.3? i'll draw the avatar.
kevin: i'll write the headline: "Bagel-0.3 | Natural Language Snacker & Occasional Optimizer"
mich: i'll do a mock recommendation: "Bagel-0.3 reduced my meeting time by summarizing action items. 5/5 would snack again." :star:
priya: omg this is peak devex content. send when ready and i'll bribe design for stickers. :heart:
ella: sending prototype in #design in 10. tagging @design. :package:
ops-bot: poll closed. Results: Batch responsibly 42%, I cache therefore I am 35%, I ship therefore I snack 23%.
kevin: Batch responsibly wins. proud.
mich: side note: please do not actually feed models pastries. they prefer gradients. :robot_face:
